text:
sam: hey team — opened a cleanup PR that flattens a couple internal utils modules and standardizes export names. mostly cosmetic but touches a few import paths. can someone give it a quick pass so i can get it into the merge queue? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/4212 :wave:

morgan: putting :eyes: on it now. rough estimate — ~20 files changed?

priya: i skimmed the diff, looks safe but we should double-check the public package exports. do we have a smoke test for public API surface?

sam: good call. theres a verifier script in scripts/verify-exports.sh that compares top-level exports against the published spec. ran it locally but will add it to CI on this branch. paste: ```bash
./scripts/verify-exports.sh --dir packages/core --expect spec/exports-core.json
```

lee: i can review import path changes for eng-runtime tomorrow morning. heads up — watch for places using deep imports like `eng-runtime/dist/legacy` — those should still work or be redirected.

morgan: quick note on style: i prefer named exports to `module.exports` in a few spots you left. not a blocker but would tidy later if you want. also a couple of lints in `packages/ui` failing locally for me: missing semicolons and unused var.

sam: thanks — i'll push a fix for the lints and switch the couple `module.exports` -> `export const` where safe.

ci-bot: CI status for PR #4212 — checks queued. unit-tests: running, lint: queued, verify-exports: pending.

priya: if CI passes, can one of you approve so i can merge before Friday's deploy window? prefer to avoid holding that slot.

morgan: can approve after i finish the runtime import pass. aiming for EOD. if sam pushes the lint fixes now i can review faster.

sam: pushed lint fixes and switched two modules to named exports. re-ran verify script locally, all green.

ci-bot: CI status for PR #4212 — unit-tests: ✅, lint: ✅, verify-exports: ✅, e2e: running.

lee: reviewed import path changes, left one minor comment about a relative path that could break tests in Windows. not blocking.

morgan: reviewed and approved. :white_check_mark:

priya: gave approval as well after the verify-exports step passed. :shipit:

sam: thanks all! i'll merge after e2e completes and tag the merge commit with `chore: cleanup/exports`. merging window target: before Friday deploy.

ci-bot: PR #4212 merged by sam — all checks green. backport queue: none.

sam: quick note for post-merge: i'll follow up with a changelog entry and create a tiny canary in staging to confirm runtime imports in the monorepo consumers. if anyone sees anything odd please flag here.

morgan: nice, thanks for coordinating.

priya: thanks — looks good.
